recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-3841 unless a future work group decision changes the Timing repeat model.
issue_request: FHIR-3841 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification MnM change request to revise the Timing structure so schedules such as Every 4-6 hours and Every 21 days for 1 hour could be represented, including range fields, units, and examples.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by historical git-svn commit db55db7414cc49a9bd93c668c9fd19c3de26fccf, whose message explicitly includes #3841 and svn revision 4758. That commit restructured source/datatypes/timing.xml, added Timing narrative examples in source/datatypes.html, and updated medication examples.
additional_context: Current source has evolved naming and scope since DSTU1, but preserves the approved capability: Timing.repeat includes frequencyMax, periodMax, durationMax, durationUnit, and periodUnit, and the Timing narrative still shows the requested frequency-range examples. source/fhir.ini keeps MedicationRequest active and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current Timing source and narrative already support the requested ranges and units in the current build.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-5347 was a ballot comment resolved by reference to this Timing restructure.
